name.description: The name of the genre (e.g., Holy Week, Kiahk, Resurrection).

rank.description: The display order for the genre, smaller numbers are higher.

description.description: A short description of the genre.

icon.description: A URL to an icon image for the genre.

backgroundUrl.description: Path to the background image file in Firebase Storage.

contentUrl.description: Path to a text file in Storage that defines sub-genre and hymn order.

active.description: Indicates if the genre is available to be displayed in the app.

cantorCloudActive.description: Indicates if the genre should be displayed in the CantorCloud filter list.

Hymn.title: Hymn
Hymn.description: Represents a hymn within a specific genre.

name.description: The title of the hymn (e.g., Tai Shouri, Agios).

genreId.description: An array of Genre IDs this hymn belongs to. (Relationship: Genre M:N Hymn)

description.description: A short description of the hymn.

lyricsEnglish.description: The English lyrics for the hymn, potentially as RTF content.

lyricsCoptic.description: The Coptic lyrics for the hymn, potentially as RTF content.

lyricsArabic.description: The Arabic lyrics for the hymn, potentially as RTF content.

Recording.title: Recording
Recording.description: Represents a specific recording of a hymn by a particular cantor.

audioUrl.description: URL to the audio file stored in Firebase Storage.

markersUrl.description: Path to the markers file in Firebase Storage. This file is the source of truth for learn mode markers.

active.description: Indicates if the recording is available to be displayed in the app.

mode.description: Determines the player mode. 'learn' shows all controls, 'listen' is for simple playback.

audioLength.description: The authoritative length of the audio file in seconds.

Cantor.title: Cantor
Cantor.description: Represents a cantor who has recorded hymns.

name.description: The name of the cantor (e.g., Cantor Tharwat, Cantor Ibrahim, Cantor Gad).

rank.description: The display order for the cantor, smaller numbers are higher.

cantorCloudActive.description: Indicates if the cantor should be displayed in the CantorCloud filter list.

/genres/{genreId}.description: Stores hymn genres (e.g., Holy Week, Kiahk, Resurrection).

/hymns/{hymnId}.description: Stores hymns, with a reference to their genre.

/recordings/{recordingId}.description: Stores all recordings for all hymns.
